echinoderm_pentaradial_test_specimen.species: Tripneustes gratilla (Linnaeus, 1758) — Camarodont regular echinoid test (aboral view) displaying five pigmented lavender-purple ambulacral rays (I-V) with paired biserial pore-pair/tubercle columns radiating at 72.0 deg intervals from the central periproct/apical system, alternating with five creamy-white interambulacral zones (1-5)

governing_equations.section: Morris (2012) Evol. Dev. 14(4):313-326; Mooi & David (1998) Am. Zool. 38:965-974; Lovén (1874) K. Sven. Vetensk.-Akad. Handl. 11(7):1-91; Duboc et al. (2005) Dev. Cell 9:147-158; Meinhardt (2008) Curr. Top. Dev. Biol. 81:1-63
governing_equations.hydrocoel_ring_gierer_meinhardt_pde: da/dt = (D_a / R_ring(t)^2) * d^2a/dtheta^2 + rho_a * (a^2 / h - a) + rho_0 * G_crescent(theta, t),   dh/dt = (D_h / R_ring(t)^2) * d^2h/dtheta^2 + rho_h * (a^2 - h)
governing_equations.circular_ring_laplacian_eigenvalue_law: - (1 / R_ring^2) * d^2(cos(m*theta))/dtheta^2 = mu_m * cos(m*theta),   mu_m = k_m^2 = (m / R_ring)^2
governing_equations.turing_angular_dispersion_relation: sigma(m; R_ring) = sigma_max - alpha_disp * ((m / R_ring)^2 - k_c^2)^2,   k_c = 2*pi / lambda_c,   m^* = argmax_{m in Z_+} sigma(m; R_ring) = round(2*pi * R_ring / lambda_c)
governing_equations.pentaradial_m5_window_law: m^* = 5  (Delta_theta = 360 deg / 5 = 72 deg)  iff  2*pi * R_ring / lambda_c in (4.5, 5.5),   i.e.  R_ring / lambda_c in (0.7162, 0.8754)
governing_equations.crescent_to_ring_closure_law: Delta_Theta_open(t) = 2*pi * (1 - gamma_close * (1 - exp(-t / tau_close))),   sequential anterior-to-posterior activation along open crescent generates Lovén sequence (II, IV, I, III, V) = (C, A, D, B, E)
governing_equations.duboc_nodal_lr_rudiment_law: N_rudiments = I(Nodal_left == 0) + I(Nodal_right == 0),   N_primary_podia = 5 * N_rudiments in {5 (WT: right Nodal), 10 (Nodal LOF: bilateral twin rudiments 2x5), 0 (Nodal GOF: bilateral Nodal repression)}
